note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. The initial and the additional claim are supplied values of this example, shown with equal weight: nothing states a rule for an additional claim (admissibility, connection, set-off, time limits) or any effect, and neither claim cancels, defeats or reduces the other.
